violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: American cheese (50F), sliced tomato (51F), and shred lettuce (50F) observed in walk in cooler. PIC stated items temperature increased due to walk in cooler door being open from moving product. Walk in cooler dropped from 51F to 46F during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Items moved into freezer to cool. PIC stated they will monitor the walk in cooler and call for maintenance if temperature does not drop to 41F or below.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the QUATERNARY AMMONIUM solution was measured at 400-500 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of QUATERNARY AMMONIUM solution at 150-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. EHS recommended diluting sanitizer solution with water to create proper concentration and having chemical company recalibrate dispenser to have proper concentration.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Sides of dryer units
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS discussed with PIC to clean exterior of fryer units to ensure grease deposits do not build up

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the TILING AT THE MOP SINK is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections behind the dry storage shelving was observed with leaking pipes. Pooled water observed on floor of dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. -Provide EHS with proof of repair to plumbing system.
